The Final Zone is now Available!

notes.title: PATCH 0.9.9
notes.content:
Added VS. Idle Mode!

Adding an alternative and personalized Marbles.

In the VS. Idle Mode Chatters can participate and try kill Quin to become the Clownslayer.
Type !spawn to spawn sheep depending on the chatters Sub- Badge.
Mods can also spawn themselves to help Quin re- educate chatters by typing !spawnMod.

Currently available mods:
Fakejon
1DoctorFrog
GiCi
Instability01
Lollus
Niller2005
ComradeNugget
Semieza
MrSkeezyMak

And others following soon!

A random mod can also be spawned by Quin himself with the same command.

One Last thing!

Soon the last Zone is finally releasing, for more Info have a watch:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HKXvJm0Gg_Y

notes.title: HOTFIX 0.9.5.2
notes.content:
ADDED Reset Buttons in Replay Zones Menu and ingame for a quick Restart

FIXED A BUG where the Speedrun Timer would reset if you didn't die during your whole run which resulted in having 0 seconds on the timer right before the boss of the Zone. 
(Not a problem Quin would encounter anyway)

FIXED A BUG where the Game would stutter every few seconds because of Twitch Chat  Connection. Twitch Chat Connection now has to be manually activated

If Quin sees this vi von

notes.title: PATCH 0.9.5
notes.content:
Added Replayable Zones!

You can now finally replay already beaten Zones.
Also test out how good you really are with the new Speedrun features.
All progress for your current speedruns are saved until you quit the game.

notes.title: PATCH 0.9.0
notes.content:
Added Zone 9!

Added new Boss
Added new Achievements
Added new Enemies

Fixed a lot of frustrating bugs that the 2 players playing this game would have never noticed anyway, send elp.

notes.title: Patch 0.8.9
notes.content:
New Feature: Streamer vs. Chat

Renamed Replay section to Arcade.

Added Twitch Integration!

Streamers can now fight against their own chatters (ingame ofc). This is a seperate mode and will stay in Beta for a while since I can't really balance it without having seen it in Action. Completing the core game first is recommended or all current Enemies and Abilities will be spoiled.

FIXED bad coding in some cases, made it worse in others, have fun!

notes.title: Patch 0.8.5
notes.content:
Balanced skills to make them all viable options

Fakejonball

Damage increased from 60 to 120
Mana cost decreased from 40 to 20
Cast time decreased from 0.6 to 0.3 seconds
Added a small knockback to enemies

Mr Skeezy Slam

Damage increased from 50 to 100
Knockback to enemies increased by 100%
Adjusted visibility to be able to see enemies hit

Niller Brand

Cooldown decreased from 2 to 1.5
Damage increased from 45 to 100
Cast time decreased from 0.3 to 0.1 seconds
Knockback to enemies increased by 100%
Speed increased by 55%
Time to drop decreased by 50%
Max Range increased by 100%

Lollus Stand

Mana cost decreased from 70 to 50

Dr Frog Buff

Cooldown decreased from 20 to 12
Cast time decreased from 0.4 to 0.2 seconds
Iron-buff duration increased from 5 to 8 seconds

notes.title: Patch 0.8.4
notes.content:
Added a new Feature:

Replay Bosses

Replay Bosses you have unlocked to improve your personal best Time and/ or unlock your Tier 3 Boss Achievements.

notes.title: PATCH 0.6.4
notes.content:
Bash and Dash now slightly reduce your hitbox to make interacting with rough edges feel a little smoother. 
( Might break the whole game, just message me if you find a Bug )

Mouse will now be confined to the game window

If you are wondering why I didn't change the Jump, well it's not an actual Issue , it's literally you not understanding the game.

notes.title: PATCH 0.6.2
notes.content:
0.6.2 

Added Scuffed Controller Support: 

Move: Left Stick 
Jump: Button South 
Attack: Button West 
Reset: "Back" / "Select" Button 
Pause: "Start" Button 
Bash: Left Shoulder/ Aim with Left Stick 
Dash: Right Shoulder 
Interact: Button West 
Change Skill: Button North 
Use current Skill: Button East

Fixed UI for Resolutions above 1080P
